invariants.description: R = 8 mu l/(pi r0^4), C = 2 pi r0^3 l/(E h), I = rho l/(pi r0^2), h = r0 (a e^{b r0} + c e^{d r0})
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs((np.concatenate((R, C, I))) - (np.concatenate((8*mu*l/(np.pi*r_0**4) + 0*t, (2*np.pi*r_0**3*l/(E*r_0*(a_vessel*np.exp(b_vessel*r_0) + c_vessel*np.exp(d_vessel*r_0)))) + 0*t, rho*l/(np.pi*r_0**2) + 0*t))))) <= 1e-08*(np.max(np.abs(np.concatenate((R, C, I)))) + np.max(np.abs(np.concatenate((8*mu*l/(np.pi*r_0**4) + 0*t, (2*np.pi*r_0**3*l/(E*r_0*(a_vessel*np.exp(b_vessel*r_0) + c_vessel*np.exp(d_vessel*r_0)))) + 0*t, rho*l/(np.pi*r_0**2) + 0*t))))) + 1e-30

invariants.description: q = q_C (+ q_C_d) + q_0 with q_0 = pi r0^2 l (unstressed volume from geometry)
u = u_0 + (q - np.pi*r_0**2*l)/(2*np.pi*r_0**3*l/(E*r_0*(a_vessel*np.exp(b_vessel*r_0) + c_vessel*np.exp(d_vessel*r_0)))) + u_ext + R_v (v_in_1 + v_in_2 - v), R_v = 0.01 s/C
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs((u) - (u_0 + (q - np.pi*r_0**2*l)/((2*np.pi*r_0**3*l/(E*r_0*(a_vessel*np.exp(b_vessel*r_0) + c_vessel*np.exp(d_vessel*r_0))))) + u_ext + (0.01/((2*np.pi*r_0**3*l/(E*r_0*(a_vessel*np.exp(b_vessel*r_0) + c_vessel*np.exp(d_vessel*r_0))))))*(v_in_1 + v_in_2 - v)))) <= 1e-08*(np.max(np.abs(u)) + np.max(np.abs(u_0 + (q - np.pi*r_0**2*l)/((2*np.pi*r_0**3*l/(E*r_0*(a_vessel*np.exp(b_vessel*r_0) + c_vessel*np.exp(d_vessel*r_0))))) + u_ext + (0.01/((2*np.pi*r_0**3*l/(E*r_0*(a_vessel*np.exp(b_vessel*r_0) + c_vessel*np.exp(d_vessel*r_0))))))*(v_in_1 + v_in_2 - v)))) + 1e-30

invariants.description: volume balance: d(q)/dt = (v_in_1 + v_in_2) - (v) (trapezoidal integral of the flows from t = 0.001 s, rel. tol 0.05)
steady state at t_end: v = v_in_1 + v_in_2
steady state at t_end: u = u_out + R (v_in_1 + v_in_2) + gravity term

bc_sweep.rationale: Boundary conditions span physiological operating values for the vessel class (arterial inlet 60-150 mmHg, venous 0-15 mmHg, flows 0-2x the nominal flow; +-0.5% for the nonlinear vv types, whose volume drifts by (v_in - v_out) t and collapses the tube if the imbalance is larger); constants are swept 0.5-2x their value; rho and mu are swept 0.5-2x their library (test_fft fixture) value of 1; beta_g 0-1; g 1-9.81; the wall-thickness constants a-d between the fixture value 1 and the proposed Blanco 2015 values. The physiological rho/mu (1050, 0.004) cannot yet be combined with the others at the run point (framework issue), so the swept regime is the library one. Excluded: tube-law exponents (they define the law), switches (R_flag, blood_ctl_dir).

baseline.reason: a single vessel under constant boundary conditions has no measured counterpart; validation needs a network assembled from these modules. Candidate: the Boileau et al. (2015) benchmark reference solutions (e.g. the aortic-bifurcation and 37-artery test cases, whose 1D reference pressure/flow waveforms are published as supplementary data), compared with a chain of these 0D segments (proposal only, not set up).
